releases.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector
releases.summary: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets with various stats, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

releases.name: Chinatsu
releases.summary: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

releases.name: Tidyspell
releases.summary: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magical cleaning game where you use telekinesis and spells to tidy a whimsical home, uncover hidden creatures, grow stronger, and explore impossible spaces, secret rooms, and mysterious portals.

releases.name: Ice Cream Truck Simulator
releases.summary: Start your engine and cool down the city! Hop into your fully interactive ice cream truck, drive through the neighborhood, and build your own ice cream empire. Take orders, scoop the perfect flavors, operate the card terminal, and manage your inventory on your ingame laptop.

releases.name: No Love No Money
releases.summary: Love or Money? Or maybe destroy both? No Love No Money is a comedy dating sim with detective elements, parodying popular anime and video game tropes.

releases.name: The Rouge Casino
releases.summary: Eight crooked casino tables, one roguelite spine. Rig the wheel, load the dice, mark the cards — stack charms, omens and gilded editions until the house edge is yours. Eight antes, eight stakes, eighty challenges, Endless beyond. No real gambling — just a casino you finally get to cheat.

releases.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!
releases.summary: A party game that gets everyone excited with a tiered chart. Arrange five words based on a given theme, and have other players guess the order. It also includes a viewer-participation mode designed for streamers. With custom genres, the possibilities for themes are endless.

releases.name: Journey TD
releases.summary: Classic tower defense meets roguelite: draft elements, combine from 167 towers, and forge your perfect build with items, runes, and a massive skill tree. Control the paths your enemies take, survive procedurally generated maps and grow stronger with every run.

releases.name: Hell is Neon Colored
releases.summary: A minimalist neon action RPG where every sound is synthesized live on a virtual sound chip and every floor is built the moment you walk into it. Assemble weapons from eight power sources and twenty-odd parts, then find out how far down your build can take you.

releases.name: THAT BOMB GAME
releases.summary: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

releases.name: The Offering Hour
releases.summary: In an arena watched by gods and demons, you are the Sacrificer. Time is your only currency — and your life: summon monsters, utter dark rites, wear the monster's skin, all paid in the hours you have left. A strategy-action roguelike. One gate — only one side walks free.

releases.name: The Red Cathedral
releases.summary:
Tsar Ivan the Terrible has ordered the construction of a cathedral in honor of his military victories. Many teams of builders will take part in the construction, but only one of them will stand out and gain the favor of the Tsar!

The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.

releases.name: White Whisper
releases.summary: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

releases.name: The Ramen Bar
releases.summary: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

releases.name: Tankii
releases.summary: A slow paced, multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.

releases.name: The Great 48
releases.summary: 48 crudely-drawn micro games! Play with just a mouse and shoot for the high score! Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!

releases.name: Potions Galore
releases.summary: Potions Galore is a cozy sorting game where you organize 2500+ potion bottles in their respective shelves. Read labels, encyclopedia descriptions and signage in order to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess!

releases.name: Big Climb
releases.summary: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.

releases.name: Project Babel (XOBOX Studio)
releases.summary: A falling-block roguelike where fast hands meet ruthless strategy. Activate runes by typing, combine Oaths to raise the Heat, and create custom maps with your own objectives and restrictions. As sanity shifts, so do the rules you must survive.

releases.name: JustLayIt
releases.summary: Just Lay It is a train survival strategy game where you lay tracks, gather resources, and fight monsters to keep a train running across the desert. Defend against waves of enemies and design efficient routes to reach your destination safely. The moment the train stops, survival ends.

releases.name: Car Parkour 4 Together
releases.summary: Team up with up to 3 players and tackle parkour courses in a town swallowed by water! Take on the Sunken Bloom and Drowned Wastes maps, overcome obstacles, create chaos with your cars, and choose between collision-free or collision-enabled gameplay with the Immunity feature!

releases.name: Chaos Table
releases.summary: A chaotic social deduction game for 6–10 players where roles never stop shifting. Talk, lie and betray your way to the very end. You can’t trust anyone here — not even the person sitting next to you. Play every angle and prove you’re the sharpest mind at the table.

releases.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up
releases.summary: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!

releases.name: Fishwake
releases.summary: Eat, grow and survive in a fast-paced underwater arcade adventure. Hunt smaller fish, evade predators, master currents and bosses, and fight your way through 50 handcrafted levels to the top of the food chain.

releases.name: Drift: Beyond Grip
releases.summary: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.

releases.name: Cubetoria: Build. Think. Solve.
releases.summary: Fill the cube with no gaps. 100 hand-made 3D polycube challenges from the Cubetoria Series 1 puzzle book, from your first 2×2×2 to expert Pro builds. Turn, tilt and snap colourful pieces into place, find every answer, keep a daily streak and build your own puzzles.

releases.name: Three Kingdoms: Wardens of the Pass
releases.summary: Hold the passes of a nightmare-haunted Three Kingdoms. Build defenses, recruit legendary generals, trigger battlefield mechanisms and turn the tide with tactical spells in pausable real-time tower defense. 18 battlefields, 13 generals, 7 defense types.

releases.name: Void Reaver
releases.summary:
You're stranded on a crumbling alien planet with nothing but your weapon and an empty backpack. To survive this sci-fi bullet heaven, you’ll need to master the art of aggressive organization and nimble movements.

Climb a towering alien monolith while facing hordes of enemies, collect experimental tech and jigsaw your inventory into an unstoppable engine of destruction. 

The Void is waiting, and your inventory space is limited.

releases.name: Clay Galaxy
releases.summary: Clay Galaxy is a cozy casual puzzle game set in a unique clay-crafted space universe. Explore small planets, solve logic challenges, and progress location by location to move further.

releases.name: SYNTAX WARS
releases.summary: A cyberpunk duel of pure reads. Both fighters lock in a move in secret, then flip at the same instant — no reflexes, no combos, just mind games. Strong eats Weak, Weak pierces Guard, Guard parries Strong. Loved the bluffing in Inscryption or the spacing in Footsies? Step into the arena.

releases.name: A to Zen: Cozy Anime Puzzle
releases.summary: A cozy anime picture puzzle. Piece together 32 hand-finished illustrations with gentle sliding and jigsaw puzzles, collect the whole alphabet from A to Z, and keep every artwork as a wallpaper. Warm music, no timers, no pressure.

releases.name: Swirl Together
releases.summary: A mesmerizing cooperative exploration for two to eight people, or a sandbox for one. Explore the colors and motion dynamics, save presets of your favorites to enjoy later and swap with others, and share a canvas with a friend, or a stranger, and make something neither of you could have made alone.

releases.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
releases.summary: Valentine's Day Word Search is a simple and fun word search puzzle game you can play with your sweetheart to celebrate Valentine's Day. Valentine's Day Word Search is quick and easy to pick up and play, and is as good as a box of chocolates for your sweetie - except this game is free!- Supports iPad, iPhone, and iPod Touch- Supports taller iPhone 5 screen size- Supports landscape and portrait gameplay- Free!

releases.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
releases.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

releases.name: Dear Nobody
releases.summary: You are a censor in a nameless war, blacking out the letters of two lovers who have never met. Their whole romance lives on paper — so every word you strike is struck from the love itself. Then the letters begin, impossibly, to answer your pen. A melancholy epistolary romance. Six endings.

releases.name: Hearth of the Deep
releases.summary: A pixel-art incremental game about a dwarf clan digging 200 levels down to rekindle the World's Heart. Break rocks, defeat guardians, hire and upgrade dwarves, grow the Rune Tree and set out on new expeditions.
